subject: pharmacology
title: Targeted anticancer: kinase inhibitors, antibodies and immunotherapy

steps.tx: **Imatinib** (BCR-ABL CML chronic phase, KIT GIST, **periorbital oedema** with cramps, cytopenias) pioneered with **resistance** (T315I ponatinib, dasatinib pleural effusions, nilotinib QT and vascular) sequencing; molecular monitoring (BCR-ABL PCR milestones) switches. GIST adjuvant years with exon 9 doubling debates. Fluid retention diuretics manage.
steps.say: CML chronic imatinib oedemas cramps; T315I ponatinib rescues. PCR milestones switch.

steps.tx: **EGFR** (**erlotinib, gefitinib**: **acneiform rash** severity predicts, diarrhoea, ILD; **osimertinib**: T790M, CNS, QT) with **ALK** (**crizotinib**: **visual trails**, QT, bradycardia; alectinib brain penetrant, myalgias; lorlatinib lipids and CNS) and **HER2** (**trastuzumab**: **cardiotoxicity** LVEF watched, infusion reactions; pertuzumab diarrhoea; T-DM1 platelets with liver) target lung and breast by mutation. Testing before treating gates; brain imaging stages ALK.
steps.say: Rash severity predicts EGFR response; visual trails crizotinib. Trastuzumab hearts echo watched.

steps.tx: **VEGF** (**bevacizumab**: **bleed, GI perforation, hypertension, proteinuria**, wound dehiscence surgery held; sunitinib hand foot with thyroid; sorafenib) with **BRAF and MEK** (**vemurafenib**: photosensitivity, SCCs; dabrafenib with trametinib **pyrexia**) and **CDK4/6** (**palbociclib**: **neutropenia** holding, QT debated; ribociclib liver) controls; elective surgery holds bevacizumab weeks. Hypertension treats through while perforation stops forever.
steps.say: Bevacizumab bleeds perforates hypertenses: surgery holds weeks. BRAF MEK fevers; palbociclib neutropenias hold.

steps.tx: **BTK** (**ibrutinib**: **atrial fibrillation with bleed**, hypertension, diarrhoea; acalabrutinib gentler, zanubrutinib) with **BCL2 venetoclax** (**tumour lysis ramp up** weekly, neutropenia) and **PARP** (**olaparib** BRCA: **anaemia** with MDS rare, nausea) treats blood and ovary; **checkpoint** (**pembrolizumab, nivolumab**: **pneumonitis, colitis, endocrinopathies**, hepatitis with high dose steroids, no chemo nausea) with **CAR-T** (**CRS tocilizumab**, ICANS steroids) immunises. Lysis labs gate venetoclax ramp.
steps.say: Ibrutinib fibrillates bleeds; venetoclax lyses ramping. Checkpoint colitis pneumonitis steroids high.
